analyst.text: Both teams are on the second night of a back-to-back. Golden State are without Stephen Curry, have lost three straight, and Draymond Green or Al Horford may sit one of the two nights. Memphis have won seven straight on the road, but Ty Jerome's hip remains a question. The angle leans towards Memphis at home.
